units: USD million; percentages and ratios labelled
inputs_source: Q2 2026 and Q3 2025 shareholder letters; H1 Brazil and financing-cost observations from June 10-Q, separately archived in cash note

content.full_year_guidance_identity: H2 cash content ~= 1.1*A_FY - 9911.018; H2 amortization = A_FY - 8529.209; H2 cash-amort ~= 0.1*A_FY - 1381.809
content.guidance_caution: 2025 audited annual amortization corroborated by annual SEC 10-K cash flow/Note 5; Q4 letter p14 is an unaudited matching display; applying issuer approximately 10% growth and approximately 1.1x cash ratio compounds rounded guidance, not a precise forecast or sustainable spending floor
content.asset_residual_caution: cash-flow additions need not equal balance-sheet asset additions; FX/other movements unresolved; do not plug residual into sustainable cash

cash.h1_receipt_tax_identity: FCF ex receipt and related paid taxes = 3819.243 + T_cash_H1; not normalized FCF
cash.h1_brazil_sensitivity_identity: If excluding all disclosed prior-period Brazil cash as nonrecurring: 4548.243 + T_cash_H1; recurrence and claim status remain uncertain
cash.sbc_identity: Cash-equivalent SBC sensitivity = 4276.526 + T_cash_H1, before other recurring adjustments; alternative claims treatment must not deduct SBC again
cash.fy_identity: FY guidance ex receipt and associated FY cash taxes ~= 9700 + T_cash_FY; do not add 729 again unless known included and deliberately excluded

earnings.tax_identity: Net income excluding receipt = 5884.205 + T_provision_receipt. Adding 85 issuance amortization also needs its own associated tax provision. Total effective tax rate cannot allocate either.
earnings.expense_warning: 85 is approximate accounting amortization, not an additional cash addback to already reconciled CFO

expectations.scope: Displayed FY2026 figures, provider last-updated Oct8; GAAP/adjusted/tax/termination FCF definitions not reconciled; no quarterly consensus

stress_interfaces.demand: Delta OI = contribution_rate * Delta revenue - Delta fixed/content expense; contribution_rate unquantified, so no numerical demand-loss forecast
stress_interfaces.content: Incremental cash payments C reduce CFO-minus-capex by C absent offsetting liability/tax/cash changes; a repeat of observed H1 cash-amort excess is a burden, not an incremental forecast
stress_interfaces.tax: Repeat of disclosed 729 prior-period cash payment reduces otherwise identical cash by 729; illustrative historical-sized shock, not probability or same-claim double counting
stress_interfaces.no_repricing: E1=E0 and M1=M0 imply unchanged earnings-capitalization support; no positive return inferred
stress_interfaces.compression: Support ratio = (E1/E0)*(M1/M0); no M or expected return selected
stress_interfaces.late: Positive thesis does not imply value > actual delayed response price; refresh evidence, claims and quote before any future decision
stress_interfaces.gap_halt_delay: No executable quote or changed event date => no assumed fill; gaps can pass stops and limits can remain unfilled

checks: Comparator Decimal/Fraction agreement and issuer cash/profit identities asserted; analytical review separate
